provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Upper Merion, Chapter 165 Zoning, as published on eCode360

checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit or in-law provision

A house that gains an additional kitchen 'shall be considered to be a two-family dwelling' (165-5 'Dwelling, single-family detached'). Two-family dwellings are not allowed in R-1A, R-1, R-2 or R-2A (165-22)
Accessory to a dwelling: 'Living quarters within the dwelling for household employees, caretakers or watch men' (165-209A(2)(c)). Not a separate unit with its own kitchen

R-3 allows two-family detached dwellings (one unit over the other) by right with 3,000 sq ft of lot per unit and a 60 ft lot width (165-59C, 165-61A). 165-61F(2) also sets 'six dwelling units per developable acre'. Ask whether that density cap reaches a two-family lot

AG, R-55A and R-55B still list 'Conversion of single-family detached dwelling, subject to ... § 165-212' as a permitted use. 165-212 was repealed 11-9-2023 by Ord. 2023-893. Ask the Zoning Officer how such a conversion is reviewed now
Accessory buildings: 14 ft, one story, in the rear quarter of the lot. Side yard for accessory use R-1A and R-1 10 ft, R-2 4 ft, R-2A 7 ft. Rear 10 ft (165-23A)
Short-term rentals are prohibited in all residential districts (165-219.9B(2))

Rental units that are not owner-occupied are regulated rental units under Chapter 132: registration, monthly rent roll and inspection when vacant (132-3, 132-5). Exempt: 'One dwelling unit that is on the same lot as a second dwelling unit', if both are occupied only by the owner and blood relatives (132-5A(2)(d))
A dimensionally nonconforming lot may be built on only if it was held in single and separate ownership when it became nonconforming and all other district rules are met (165-199E)
Parking for a house: two spaces plus one for each bedroom over three. The first garage space does not count (165-191A(1))

term.note: No ADU term. Searched for accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, ECHO, elder cottage, carriage house, guest house, caretaker, secondary dwelling, second dwelling, accessory family, accessory residential, accessory unit, au pair, servant, conversion, kitchen. 165-209A(2)(c) allows 'living quarters within the dwelling for household employees, caretakers or watch men', which is not a dwelling unit.

status.note: The code has no ADU text. A house with an additional kitchen 'shall be considered to be a two-family dwelling'.

path.note: Reading: R districts allow listed uses 'and no other'. A second kitchen makes a two-family dwelling, which R-1A to R-2A do not list. A use variance is the path.

fallback_path.note: Same as path. Residential district use lists have no similar-use special exception. Only commercial, NMU and KPMU districts have one.

value.name: Two-family detached dwelling (one unit over the other)
value.conditions: Table: 3,000 sq ft of lot per unit, 60 ft width. But 165-61A(1) is 'Subject to the limitations of Subsection F' and F(2) caps density at 'six dwelling units per developable acre', which reads as about 14,520 sq ft of developable land for two units. Side yards 10 ft min, 25 ft aggregate. Coverage 30%.

value.name: Conversion of single-family detached dwelling
value.conditions: Listed, but its standards were repealed. The use reads 'subject to the provisions of ... § 165-212', and 165-212 was repealed 11-9-2023 (Ord. 2023-893). Ask the Zoning Officer whether the listing still works. Not a settled by-right path.

alternatives.note: Not ADUs. Both are readings: the R-3 lot follows the 165-61F(2) density cap (two units at six per developable acre), and the AG, R-55A, R-55B conversion lost its standards in 2023.

zoning_districts.note: No district lists an ADU. Reading of a silent code.

historic_bypass.note: No ADU text, so no historic path.

types_allowed.note: No ADU form is listed. A second kitchen makes the house a two-family dwelling.

max_height_ft.note: Accessory rule, not an ADU rule. Accessory buildings '14 feet, not exceeding one story'.

setback_side_ft.note: Accessory side yard differs by district. See districts. Accessory use 'must be located within the rear quarter of the lot.'

setback_rear_ft.note: Accessory rear yard differs by district: 10 ft in R-1A to R-2A, 5 ft in R-3. See districts.

family_only.note: No ADU rule. A family may include one person unrelated to the others.

max_adus.note: Reading: 0 means the code allows no ADU.

short_term_rental_banned.note: Short-term rentals 'shall be specifically prohibited' in R-1A, R-1, R-2, R-2A, R-3 and other residential districts.

spaces_required.note: No ADU row. A house: 'two spaces plus one additional space for each bedroom in excess of three bedrooms.'
